# white_moka_pot — articulation audit

**Status: FAIL — repaired mechanism; source validation remains incomplete.**

Audited joint: `lid_hinge`. Source: `IMG_1311.MOV`, dense 38–49 s scan, registered f1208/f1223/f1367, and all six inventory contact sheets. No lid opening was found. The measured fronts and splat joint tables contain no moka joint.

Changes:
- Replaced the interior pivot and overlapping solid hinge housing with a rear-rim pivot and separate moving/fixed knuckles.
- Rebuilt the handle attachment and replaced oversized axis-aligned grip colliders with circular sections normal to its centerline. The lid contact hull now includes the raised roof and full knob.
- Reduced the over-projecting pouring nose to match the shallow source lip; evaluated common pose/scale candidates, retained the original dimensions, and selected one common position and yaw while preserving silhouette overlap.
- Added MuJoCo and URDF exports, a hinge-centered GLB node, front vector and preferred view. Preserved the joint name, textures, mass/friction priors and provisional 0–1.8 rad range.
- Added a seated screw assembly coupling so the collector and boiler do not fall apart at rest. Thread release and helical motion remain unmodeled.

Rest rim: tilt 0.00000000 deg; coplanarity 0.00000000 mm; maximum sampled clearance 0.00000000 mm over 520 samples.
MuJoCo: before penetration 7.880766 mm; after 0.0000000000 mm over 10 requested samples. 184 additional samples: 0.0000000000 mm. Numerical tolerance is 0.001 mm. Parent/child collision filtering is disabled; no exclusions hide hinge collisions.
Visual triangle checks: positive-angle sweep PASS; closed rim touch is checked by signed contacts.

Photo alignment (maximum symmetric boundary distance, native 1280×1707):
- f1367, q=0: body 23.54 px, lid 43.05 px — FAIL.
- f1208, q=0: body 30.27 px, lid 13.04 px — FAIL.

Remaining failures:
- The 10 px / 1 cm alignment requirement is not certified: source contour residuals remain. Manual boundary uncertainty is approximately 4 px; it does not excuse the larger residuals. Further geometry/registration reconciliation is needed.
- The hidden physical hinge axis cannot be measured to 2 degrees / 5 mm. The corrected mechanism is a geometrically consistent rear-hinge proxy, not recovered hidden hardware.
- No actuated frames or physical stop are available; observed-range coverage and the decisive two-frame actuated reprojection test therefore FAIL. Synthetic open renders are explicitly labeled and never counted as source observations.
- The original stop of 1.8 rad (103.13 degrees) is retained as an unverified prior. Closed-view matching cannot validate it.
- Existing shelf support mismatch belongs to the neighboring cabinetry set and was not edited. New fitted pose is authoritative here; full scene support reconciliation remains necessary.

Review: `../review/artcheck_white_moka_pot.jpg` (photo | CPU Cycles render at observed closed q | overlay), `../review/artcheck_white_moka_pot_sweep.jpg` (synthetic only).
